de.purpose: Zur Dokumentation der erzeugten elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens über einen kurzen Zeitraum und der entsprechenden klinischen Interpretation.
de.use:
Verwenden Sie diesen Archetyp zur Dokumentation der Ergebnisse eines 3-, 5-, 12-, 15- oder 18-Kanal-Elektrokardiogramms (EKG), sowie der entsprechenden klinischen Interpretation. Jede EKG Variante kann durch ein separates Template weiter eingeschränkt werden um eine einfache Wiederverwendung zu erlauben.

Das standardmäßig gesetzte 'Beliebiges Ereignis' kann in Templates oder bei Laufzeit eingeschränkt werden, um spezifische EKG Messungen während körperlicher Betätigung oder Belastung aufzuzeichnen.
de.misuse:
Nicht zur Aufzeichnung der Ergebnisse von ambulanter Herzüberwachung oder stationärer Telemetrie verwenden.

Nicht zur Aufzeichnung von Ergebnisse der transösophagealen Echokardiografie Untersuchung (TEE) verwenden.

nb.purpose: For å registrere målinger av elektrisk aktivitet generert av hjertet i en kort tidsperiode, og kliniske tolkninger av denne målingen.
nb.use:
Brukes for å registrere resultatene av et 3-, 5-, 12-, 15- eller 18-avlednings elektrokardiogram (EKG), og tilknyttede kliniske tolkninger. Hver variant av EKG kan uttrykkes som tilpasninger av arketypen i et templat, for å legge til rette for enkel gjenbruk.

"Uspesifisert hendelse" kan tilpasses i templater eller applikasjoner for å spesifikt registrere EKGer som er tatt under fysisk belastning.
nb.misuse:
Skal ikke brukes for å registrere resultater fra ambulatorisk EKG-monitorering eller telemetri.

Skal ikke brukes for å registrere resultater fra transøsofageal elektrokardiografi.

ar-sy.purpose: لتسجيل تفسير تخطيط كهربية القلب عن النشاط الكهربي للقلب باستخدام جهيزة مخطط كهربية القلب.
ar-sy.use:
يستخدم لتسجيل تفاصيل تخطيط كهربية القلب الذي يستخدم 12 اتجاه بما في ذلك المعايير و التفسير.
يستخدم لتسجيل تفاصيل اختبارات تخطيط كهربية القلب الذي يتم إجراؤه في أثناء المجهود البدني و الاختبار عند وجود ضغط.
ar-sy.misuse:
لا يستخدم لتسجيل الاتجهات غير العيارية لتخطيط كهربية القلب.
لا يستخدم لتسجيل مِرقَب /مِنطَر هولتر.

en.purpose: To record the measurements of electrical activity generated by the heart over a short period of time and its associated clinical interpretation.
en.use:
Use to record the results of a 3-, 5-, 12-, 15- or 18-lead electrocardiograph (ECG) and its associated clinical interpretation. Each ECG variation can be constrained in a separate template to allow for easy re-use.

The default 'Any event' can be constrained in templates or at run time to specifically record ECGs conducted during exercise or under stress-testing conditions.
en.misuse:
Not to be used to record the results from ongoing cardiac monitoring or telemetry.

Not to be used to record results from trans-oesophageal electrophysiological studies.

at0007.1.description: Interval measurement from the onset of the QRS complex to the end of the T wave aacross the ECG as a whole (multiple leads).

at0009.1.description: Interpretative comment on this ECG result, originating from a device.
at0009.1.comment: May be multiple. Coding of the interpretation with a terminology is preferred, where possible. For example: normal sinus rhythm; ischaemic ST-T changes in anterior leads; and/or poor R progression in right precordial leads.

at0020.1.description: Average direction of electrical activity during atrial depolarization.
at0020.1.comment: For example: normal axis or left deviation; or number of degrees.

at0022.1.description: Average direction of electrical activity during ventricular repolarization.
at0022.1.comment: For example: normal axis or left deviation; or number of degrees.

at0014.1.description: Duration of QRS complex across the ECG as a whole (multiple leads).
at0014.1.comment:
The QRS complex is measured from its onset to 
the ST segment onset (J point).

at0012.1.description: PR interval measurement across the ECG as a whole (multiple leads).
at0012.1.comment: The PR interval is measured from onset of P wave to the onset of QRS complex.

at0021.1.description: Average direction of electrical activity during ventricular depolarization.
at0021.1.comment: For example: normal axis or left deviation; or number of degrees.
